name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
summary: High Executor Derrington asks you to seek him at the Bulwark. His camp lies east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

sections.title: At the Bulwark
sections.body: At the Bulwark, High Executor Derrington is waiting for you. His base camp lies east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity, where you are asked to find him.
